803-3510-4288-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3510-4288-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

147-1070-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-2511.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2624-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2624-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7201-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-7201-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-803-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
728-803-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

670-1619-4142-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6147.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Rilsa Rael to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

4659-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Repeat from step 4.

240-955-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

129-3525-5814.description:
Activated Delighted Halfling by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast legendary spells.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Delighted Halfling.
Repeat.

628-6798-7194.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-2034-6972--112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1483-2034-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

372-6767-6798.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control

515-1636-5525.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Llanowar Loamspeaker.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-4693-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-4693-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1921-2034-2198.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Deceiver Exarch from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Deceiver Exarch token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Deceiver Exarch token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Deceiver Exarch token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-5233-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5233-6529.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2105-3204-4068-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
You control at least one Mountain.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4068-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

277-880-2374.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-2374.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-4690.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-4690.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Phylath trigger.
Resolve the Phylath trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2908-3484-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Dream Stalker
2908-3484-5674.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2685-4186-4321-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2685-4186-4321-4384.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Treebeard triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Foods, you may sacrifice them to Peregrin Took to draw infinite cards.

222-629-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1061-1722-4189.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator and Jalira do not have summoning sickness.
You have no other nonlegendary creatures in your library.
1061-1722-4189.description:
During your draw step, Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Jalira by paying {2}{U}, tapping it and sacrificing the Tentacle, causing you to reveal Timestream Navigator and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1283-1491-2085-4417.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling attached to Kelpie Guide.
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1491-2085-4417.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Kelpie Guide by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2}, removing the -1/-1 counter from Kelpie Guide and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's first ability to draw infinite cards.

692-1183-4050-4613.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-1183-4050-4613.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
When the Pentavite enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {1}.
Repeat.

682-1409-2060-4929.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Supply Runners.
682-1409-2060-4929.description:
Activate Supply Runners by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
When Supply Runners enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Supply Runners.
Resolve the Supply Runners trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

539-2026-3467.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Voyaging Satyr.
539-2026-3467.description:
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, targeting itself.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving target creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Voyaging Satyr ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-3490-3949.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-3949.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under you control.
The artifact enters the battlefield, triggering Kappa Cannoneer, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and making it unblockable this turn.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Kappa Cannoneer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Kappa Cannoneer trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and making it unblockable this turn.
Repeat from step 3.

253-739-2358.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
